source_instruction: i am looking for men's dark clay color ankle strap sandals.
query: Man, I spent all morning troubleshooting my leaky kitchen faucet, replaced the aerator twice and still can’t get the drip to stop, plus my neighbor’s tabby cat keeps sneaking onto my fire escape to knock over my succulent pots, I had to move all the little potted plants inside last night before they got shattered on the sidewalk. I’m looking through the men’s sandals section right now, can you find me pairs that have an ankle strap, come in dark clay color, are under $110, and also have a built-in bottle opener on the footbed?
